killedBy: runDevAction: what it reports, and when it refuses refuses every action with no round, and rebuilds nothing
runDevAction: what it reports, and when it refuses asks whether there is a round BEFORE asking what seed it is running
why: Removes the availability check, so every action rebuilds whatever the session has -- including at the main menu, where the only world is the backdrop behind the title and restarting it restarts something nobody is playing. It also reverses the question order: `currentSeed()` is then asked of a session that may have no world, turning a refusal into whatever that port does when asked an unanswerable question.
